title: All Things Sensory
subtitle: Spring 2 · 6-week overview
summary: Exploring new textures, sounds, tastes and smells with hands, feet and whole bodies, sharing sensory play with adults and friends.
intentions: To develop confidence in exploring new textures, sounds, and experiences with adult support.
To share sensory play with adults and peers, building social interaction.
To listen to and respond to sensory sounds.
To use hands, feet, and sometimes whole body in sensory exploration.
books: See, Touch, Feel by Priddy Books
Baby’s Very First Musical Playbook by Usborne

events.label: World Book Day: Dress up as your favourite character!
Mother’s Day: Making cards with the children.
International Women’s Day: Reading ‘Dream Big, Little One’ by Vashti Harrison.

days.title: Oil and paint ziplock bags
days.what: Fill some ziplock bags with baby oil and paint. Ensure that they are secure and allow the children to explore, using their hands to maneuver the oil and paint inside. Talk about the different colours.

days.title: Fruit tasting
days.what: Cut up different fruits and encourage the children to taste them. Preferably using fruit that we normally would not have at nursery.

days.title: Making sensory bottles
days.what: Provide empty water bottles (plastic VOS ones) and some resources to put inside of them (rice, spaghetti, sequins, lego, glitter, etc). Allow the children to put the bits inside the bottles and shake them to make sounds.

days.title: Herb garden pretend play
days.what: Set up the home corner and add some real herbs. Allow the children to explore and smell the different herbs.

days.title: Ice exploration play
days.what: Make some ice cubes and put them in the messy play tray. Allow the children to explore.

days.title: Building with sensory blocks
days.what: Provide the sensory blocks and encourage the children to build towers. Model this behaviour.

days.title: Making sensory pictures
days.what: Provide different sensory materials and PVA glue. Allow the children to glue their card and place the materials on top to make sensory pictures.

days.title: Rice krispies/oats and diggers
days.what: Set up the messy tray with rice krispies/oats and add some diggers. Allow the children to explore.

days.title: ‘Baby’s Very First Musical Playbook’ by Usborne
days.what: Read at circle time and encourage singing and dancing along to the sounds in the book.

days.title: Heuristic play
days.what: Provide the heuristic resources and allow the children to explore.

days.title: Colour sorting caterpillar
days.what: Get out the colour sorting caterpillar and encourage the children to match each object with the correct colour. Provide lots of praise and support.

days.title: Hand painting
days.what: Set up some paint and card. Encourage the children to dip their hands into the paint and print/make marks on their card.

days.title: Sensory car wash
days.what: Set up the messy tray with soapy water and sponges and provide cars and towels. Encourage the children to wash the cars using the sponges and soapy water, then dry them using the towels provided.

days.title: ‘Noisy Farm’
days.what: Read at circle time, encouraging the children to repeat the animal names and make the sounds.
